7.2.4.13 Non-default sessions
The Dcm supports the ISO14229-1 [1] defined sessions. There are two kind of sessions, the default session and the non-default sessions. In a non-default session the S3 timer is used to detect inactive testers and if the timer elapses the default session is entered.
[SWS_Dcm_01668] S3Server session timer support Upstream requirements: RS_Diag_04249
⌈The Dcm shall support the S3Server and start and stop this timer according to ISO14229-2 [3].⌋ Manager
[SWS_Dcm_01669] Sessions and connections Upstream requirements: RS_Diag_04249
⌈The Dcm shall start or stop the S3Server according to ISO14229-2 [3] but only for the client on the DcmDslConnection that requested the non-default session.⌋
[SWS_Dcm_01670] Change to default session upon S3Server elapses Upstream requirements: RS_Diag_04249
⌈If the S3Server elapses, the Dcm shall switch back to default session.⌋
